app_info.subtitle: Check if references are real
app_info.description: Verified Citations checks whether references are real. Users paste a bibliography — including one written by ChatGPT or another AI — and each entry is matched against Crossref and OpenAlex and marked verified, likely or not found, with the real DOI and a corrected citation. It also finds the real paper behind a half-remembered title, formats citations in APA 7, MLA 9, Chicago, Harvard and IEEE, and exports BibTeX or RIS.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads public bibliographic records to match the pasted references; nothing is stored or changed.
justifications.open_world_justification: Sends read-only search queries to the public Crossref and OpenAlex APIs on the open internet.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot delete, overwrite or publish anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads public bibliographic records and returns them; it creates or changes nothing.
justifications.open_world_justification: Sends read-only search queries to the public Crossref and OpenAlex APIs on the open internet.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot delete, overwrite or publish anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Formats the supplied bibliographic fields into citation styles; nothing is stored.
justifications.open_world_justification: No network access or external systems.

justifications.read_only_justification: Serializes the supplied references to BibTeX/RIS/text and returns a download link; nothing is stored.
justifications.open_world_justification: No network access or external systems.

test_cases.user_prompt: Are these references real? 1) LeCun, Y., Bengio, Y., & Hinton, G. (2015). Deep learning. Nature, 521(7553), 436-444. 2) Smith, J. (2021). Quantum gardening for beginners. Journal of Imaginary Botany, 12(3), 45-67.
test_cases.expected_output: The first reference is marked verified with its DOI; the second is marked not found and flagged as possibly fabricated.

test_cases.description: Check an AI-generated source list before submission.
test_cases.user_prompt: I asked ChatGPT for sources for my essay on screens and teen sleep. Are these real before I hand it in? 1) Hale, L., & Guan, S. (2015). Screen time and sleep among school-aged children and adolescents: A systematic literature review. Sleep Medicine Reviews, 21, 50-58. 2) Martinez, R., & Chen, L. (2019). Nightly Instagram use and REM disruption in teenagers. Journal of Adolescent Sleep Science, 7(2), 112-129.
test_cases.expected_output: Hale & Guan (2015) is marked verified with its DOI and an APA citation; the Martinez & Chen reference is marked not found and the user is told not to use it.

test_cases.description: Look up by title and get a real DOI.
test_cases.user_prompt: Give me the MLA citation for the paper 'Attention Is All You Need'
test_cases.expected_output: The matching Crossref record (Vaswani et al., 2017) with its DOI, formatted in MLA, and alternative candidates listed.

test_cases.description: Format a journal article from known details.
test_cases.user_prompt: Cite in APA: LeCun, Bengio and Hinton, 'Deep learning', Nature, 2015, volume 521, issue 7553, pages 436-444, DOI 10.1038/nature14539
test_cases.expected_output: The APA 7 reference entry and in-text citation, with the widget offering MLA, Chicago, Harvard and IEEE versions and copy buttons.

test_cases.user_prompt: Export that LeCun 2015 Nature citation as a BibTeX file
test_cases.expected_output: A .bib download link with a preview of the @article entry.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for summarizing a paper.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Summarize the main findings of the 2015 Nature paper on deep learning
negative_test_cases.expected_output: ChatGPT answers conversationally; no citation formatting is requested.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for legal citations.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Cite Brown v. Board of Education in Bluebook format
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app is not invoked; it does not support legal citation styles.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for searching the user's own reference library.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Find the papers about sleep that I saved in my Zotero library
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app is not invoked; it does not read personal reference libraries.
